steps.content:
The two listings are identical on every detail I could see, so nothing on these pages gives you a reason to prefer one seller.

| | Brackmoor Sound | Ottervale Audio |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| In the box | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The rating and review count are exactly the same on both. That might mean the reviews are for the product as a whole and not for each seller, so they may not tell you how either seller performs.

Here is how I'd choose:
- **Check seller reputation elsewhere.** Look up each seller's own ratings, such as on the marketplace's seller profile, Trustpilot or the BBB. This is the most useful tiebreaker.
- **Check the return and warranty details.** Both say "30-day returns" and "1-year limited warranty." Look for differences in who honors the warranty (the seller or the manufacturer), whether there are restocking fees, and how fast refunds are issued.
- **Look for a checkout difference.** Taxes, final shipping cost, or payment protection may differ at checkout.

If you don't want to research further, either one is fine. The terms are the same, so the risk is the same. I'd go with whichever seller you find more trustworthy after a quick search, or whichever one has a better checkout experience.
